newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady in quiet activity late on Wednesday, holding onto strong gains made at midday, players said.
"There was a flurry this morning, but this afternoon there was not much talk," said one Houston trader.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, propane remained between 49.75 cents and 50.00 cents a gallon, after jumping 1.50 cents this morning in line with strong NYMEX October crude oil futures.
A major fractionator was also looking to buy barrels in the Belvieu market, helping to support prices, players said.
Conway, Kansas, hub material also stayed steady.
"There is not much news this afternoon," said one Conway trader, adding that many eyes were still fixed on the crisis in Iraq.
Activities among the heavies remained quiet all day, due to an industry event in Dallas for LPG marketers.
-- Laney Salisbury New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
